SELECT base.学院, base.专业, COALESCE(SUM(temp.`纵向科研项目-校级以上`), 0) AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, COALESCE(SUM(temp.`纵向科研项目-校级`), 0) AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, COALESCE(SUM(temp.`横向课题科研项目`), 0) AS `横向课题科研项目`, MAX(COALESCE(temp.`成果转化`, '0个（0）万')) AS `成果转化`, COALESCE(SUM(temp.`学术论文`), 0) AS `学术论文`, COALESCE(SUM(temp.`教材著作`), 0) AS `教材著作`, COALESCE(SUM(temp.专利), 0) AS 专利, COALESCE(SUM(temp.软著), 0) AS 软著, COALESCE(SUM(temp.奖励类), 0) AS 奖励类, COALESCE(SUM(temp.学术报告), 0) AS 学术报告 FROM ( -- 基础表：获取所有学院和专业 SELECT p.dept_name AS 学院, d.dept_name AS 专业 FROM sys_dept d JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id WHERE p.parent_id = 100 -- 根部门ID假设为100，按实际情况调整 ) base LEFT JOIN ( -- 合并所有统计数据的子查询 SELECT 学院, 专业, `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, `纵向科研项目-校级`, `横向课题科研项目`, `成果转化`, `学术论文`, `教材著作`, 专利, 软著, 奖励类, 学术报告 FROM ( -- 纵向科研项目-校级以上 SELECT parten.dept_name AS 学院, dept.dept_name AS 专业, COALESCE(SUM(subquery.count_type), 0) AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT a.user_id, COUNT(*) AS count_type FROM sci_horizontal_apply_vertical AS a WHERE a.top_type NOT IN (6,7) AND a.state = 66 GROUP BY a.user_id ) AS subquery JOIN sys_user AS user ON user.user_id = subquery.user_id JOIN sys_dept AS dept ON user.dept_id = dept.dept_id JOIN sys_dept AS parten ON parten.dept_id = dept.parent_id GROUP BY parten.dept_name, dept.dept_name
UNION ALL
-- 纵向科研项目-校级 SELECT parten.dept_name AS 学院, dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, COALESCE(SUM(subquery.count_type), 0) AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT a.user_id, COUNT(*) AS count_type FROM sci_horizontal_apply_vertical AS a WHERE a.top_type IN (6,7) AND a.state = 66 GROUP BY a.user_id ) AS subquery JOIN sys_user AS user ON user.user_id = subquery.user_id JOIN sys_dept AS dept ON user.dept_id = dept.dept_id JOIN sys_dept AS parten ON parten.dept_id = dept.parent_id GROUP BY parten.dept_name, dept.dept_name
UNION ALL
-- 横向课题科研项目 SELECT parten.dept_name AS 学院, dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, COALESCE(SUM(subquery.count_amount), 0) AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT a.user_id, COUNT(*) AS count_amount FROM sci_horizontal_apply AS a WHERE a.state = 6 GROUP BY a.user_id ) AS subquery JOIN sys_user AS user ON user.user_id = subquery.user_id JOIN sys_dept AS dept ON user.dept_id = dept.dept_id JOIN sys_dept AS parten ON parten.dept_id = dept.parent_id GROUP BY parten.dept_name, dept.dept_name
UNION ALL
-- 转化成果 SELECT p1.d2n AS 学院, p1.dn AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, COALESCE(CONCAT(p1.count, '个（', p1.amount, '）万'), '0个（0）万') AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT d2.dept_name AS d2n, d.dept_name AS dn, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM sci_IntraSchPro_apply sc LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = sc.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d2 ON d2.dept_id = d.parent_id WHERE sc.state = 6 GROUP BY d.dept_id ) p1
UNION ALL
-- 学术论文 SELECT subquery.parent_dept_name AS 学院, subquery.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, COALESCE(SUM(subquery.SCI + subquery.EI + subquery.核心 + subquery.三网 + subquery.普通 + subquery.校办), 0) AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT parent_dept_alias.dept_name AS parent_dept_name, d_dept.dept_name AS dept_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SCI, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EI, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 核心, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 三网, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 普通, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 校办 FROM ( SELECT p1.paper_title, p1.paper_category, u.dept_id, p1.paper_ranking, title_counts.title_count FROM sci_paper_a p1 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p1.user_id = u.user_id JOIN ( SELECT paper_title, COUNT(*) AS title_count FROM sci_paper_a GROUP BY paper_title ) title_counts ON p1.paper_title = title_counts.paper_title WHERE p1.state = 8 ) p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON p.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept parent_dept_alias ON d_dept.parent_id = parent_dept_alias.dept_id WHERE (p.title_count = 1) OR (p.title_count > 1 AND p.paper_ranking = 1) GROUP BY d_dept.dept_id, parent_dept_alias.dept_name, d_dept.dept_name ) subquery GROUP BY subquery.parent_dept_name, subquery.dept_name
UNION ALL
-- 教材著作 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT a1.id), 0) AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT a1.id, a1.user_id FROM sci_jiaocairuanzhu a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT mingcheng, MIN(paiming) AS min_paiming FROM sci_jiaocairuanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY mingcheng ) a2 ON a1.mingcheng = a2.mingcheng AND a1.paiming = a2.min_paiming ) a1 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON a1.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id INNER JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id
UNION ALL
-- 专利 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a1.fenlei IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT a1.id, a1.fenlei, a1.paiming, a1.user_id FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT mingcheng, MIN(paiming) AS min_paiming FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY mingcheng ) a2 ON a1.mingcheng = a2.mingcheng AND a1.paiming = a2.min_paiming ) a1 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON a1.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id INNER JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id WHERE p_dept.parent_id = 100 GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id
UNION ALL
-- 软著 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a1.fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT a1.id, a1.fenlei, a1.paiming, a1.user_id, a2.mingcheng FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT mingcheng, MIN(paiming) AS min_paiming FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY mingcheng ) a2 ON a1.mingcheng = a2.mingcheng AND a1.paiming = a2.min_paiming ) a1 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON a1.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id INNER JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id
UNION ALL
-- 奖励类 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, COALESCE(COUNT(s.id), 0) AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM sys_reward s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id WHERE s.state = 6 GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id
UNION ALL
-- 学术报告 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, COALESCE(COUNT(s.id), 0) AS 学术报告 FROM sci_lecture_report s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id ) all_data ) temp ON base.学院 = temp.学院 AND base.专业 = temp.专业 WHERE base.专业 = (SELECT dept_name FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id = (SELECT dept_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = CURRENT_USER())) GROUP BY base.学院, base.专业 ORDER BY base.学院, base.专业

-- 软著 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a1.fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM ( SELECT a1.id, a1.fenlei, a1.paiming, a1.user_id, a2.mingcheng FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT mingcheng, MIN(paiming) AS min_paiming FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY mingcheng ) a2 ON a1.mingcheng = a2.mingcheng AND a1.paiming = a2.min_paiming ) a1 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON a1.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id INNER JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id
UNION ALL
-- 奖励类 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, COALESCE(COUNT(s.id), 0) AS 奖励类, 0 AS 学术报告 FROM sys_reward s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id WHERE s.state = 6 GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id
UNION ALL
-- 学术报告 SELECT p_dept.dept_name AS 学院, d_dept.dept_name AS 专业, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, 0 AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, 0 AS `横向课题科研项目`, 0 AS `成果转化`, 0 AS `学术论文`, 0 AS `教材著作`, 0 AS 专利, 0 AS 软著, 0 AS 奖励类, COALESCE(COUNT(s.id), 0) AS 学术报告 FROM sci_lecture_report s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d_dept ON u.dept_id = d_dept.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p_dept ON d_dept.parent_id = p_dept.dept_id GROUP BY p_dept.dept_id, d_dept.dept_id ) temp;
